name: orange-cab-monorepo
description: Orange Cab - Premium Cab Booking Website & Admin Panel (MERN Stack)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT,ADMIN" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install && cd ../admin && npm install
scripts.install:apps: npm ci --prefix client && npm ci --prefix admin
scripts.install:vercel: npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix client && npm ci --prefix admin
